## Recent entries (2026) — new API/resource/entity additions

### June 19, 2026
- Tenants: added `migrate` method to crossTenantMigrationJob resource.
- Security: new `policyTipAction` resource; added `policyTip` member to dlpAction enum.
- Tasks & Plans: new resources plannerTaskData, plannerTaskDetailsData, plannerHistoryItem; added historyEntityType/historyEventType enums; historyItems relationship on plannerPlan.
- Teamwork & Communications: new cloudVideoInteropInfo resource; added cloudVideoInteropInfo, isRegistrationRequired, meetingType properties across meeting/virtual-event resources.

### June 18, 2026
- Identity & Access: new enumeration types and resources for access package suggestions; added filterByCurrentUser method.

### June 17, 2026
- Applications: new redirectUri configuration resources (domain- and scheme-based URI controls).
- Security: new account and file action resources; new entity-mapping resources for detection; enhanced detectionRule properties.

### June 16, 2026
- Mail: new distributionList resource type; new distributionListMember resource; distribution-list management methods.

### Earlier June 2026
- Files container permission enhancements; identity governance workflow extensions; FIDO2 auth method improvements; application risk assessment resources; backup/restore session enhancements.

Updated: 2026-07-06 — First scan with usable content (prior cache was nav-chrome only). Entries above captured via RSS.
